results.rationale: Relevant HMIS/hospital IT deployments are evidenced, but the records do not explicitly demonstrate rollout/integration across four tertiary-care hospitals as a single integrated program.

Hospital IT experience supports the general HMIS module scope, but HL7/FHIR-based integration and the full listed module set (EMR, LIS/RIS, DWH/dashboards) are not explicitly evidenced in the summaries.
Hospital IT deployment experience is related, but none of the cited records explicitly confirms legacy patient record migration as a delivered component.
Training is a standard delivery obligation credibly supported by multiple hospital IT deployment records and our organizational delivery/support footprint.

We can credibly commit to support/maintenance based on our support model and enterprise deployments, but the evidence does not explicitly show delivering a full three-year post-implementation support term.
Company profile explicitly confirms FBR National Tax Number with Active Taxpayer List (ATL) status.
Company profile explicitly lists ISO 27001 as a held certification, meeting the mandatory requirement.
The requirement is for CMMI Level 5, but our company profile and project records show CMMI Level 3 only, with no evidence of a valid Level 5 appraisal.
